description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Futridge, an HR consultancy, is recruiting for an unnamed company’s early-career rotational program. The role provides hands-on experience in professional services, customer engagement, product development, and industrial automation, while supporting client solutions and digital transformation projects.
Technology Analyst supporting industrial automation consulting, implementing IoT/ML/AR and PLM/SCM/ERP solutions for client innovation and operations

Responsibilities:
• Participate in many learning experiences including formal classroom training, leadership development, mentoring, career planning, networking, and exposure to the company’s global engineering teams and businesses
• Directly contribute to business-critical projects and tasks, which may include roles/experiences in commercial content creation, application development, product development and management, customer engagement, technical consulting, and much more!
• Work with industrial automation technology that is developed within the company’s major business segments to support The Connected Enterprise. This may include software for automation, programmable automation controllers, intelligent motor control, machine safety, process control, industrial security, cloud computing, industrial Ethernet, motion control, industrial components, variable-frequency drives, and more
• Work with team of fellow consultants to deliver customer solutions and implementations
• Design and implement disruptive digital technologies like Internet of Things, Machine Learning, and Augmented Reality to help the company's clients drive business model innovation, enable new customer experiences, and build new internal capabilities
• Optimize client's new innovation, product development, manufacturing and broader supply chain processes and deploy supportive enterprise technologies like Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Portfolio Management (PPM), Supply Chain Planning & Management (SCM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or advanced degree from an accredited college or university
• Permanent legal authorization to work in the US is required
• The company will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future

Preferred:
• Graduated in the past three years with a technically focused degree
• Met us through an event or interned with the company in the past
• A cumulative GPA of 3.5+ on a 4.0 scale
• Demonstrated experience approaching challenges with innovative solutions
• Demonstrated organizational strategies to meet team goals and timelines
